summary: Sleep draws an open hand down over the face as the fingers close, with the eyes closing too.
handshape: Open hand closing to a flattened O
movement: Hand moves down the face and closes
steps: Hold an open hand in front of your face, palm toward you.
Draw it down toward your chin while closing the fingers to a flattened O.
Close your eyes and tilt your head slightly as the hand comes down.
mistakes: Keeping the eyes open and the head up. The face sleeps with the hand.
